question: Determine the equation of the unique plane passing through the three points $A(1,0,1)$, $B(2,1,0)$ and $C(0,2,1)$, expressing the result in both vector and Cartesian forms and verifying that the three given points lie on the obtained plane.
explanation:
Formation of a Normal Vector
The vectors joining $A$ to $B$ and $A$ to $C$ are
$$\overrightarrow{AB}=(2-1)\hat{i}+(1-0)\hat{j}+(0-1)\hat{k}=\hat{i}+\hat{j}-\hat{k}$$
and
$$\overrightarrow{AC}=(0-1)\hat{i}+(2-0)\hat{j}+(1-1)\hat{k}=-\hat{i}+2\hat{j}$$
Their cross product is
$$\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=\begin{vmatrix}\hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k}\\1&1&-1\\-1&2&0\end{vmatrix}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$$
Since this cross product is non-zero, the three points are non-collinear and hence determine a unique plane. A normal vector to the plane is therefore $\vec{N}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$.

Vector Equation
The position vector of $A$ is $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+\hat{k}$. The equation of a plane through the point with position vector $\vec{a}$ and perpendicular to the normal vector $\vec{N}$ is
$$\left(\vec{r}-\vec{a}\right)\cdot\vec{N}=0$$
Thus, the required vector equation is
$$\left[\vec{r}-(\hat{i}+\hat{k})\right]\cdot(2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+3\hat{k})=0$$

Cartesian Form
Writing $\vec{r}=x\hat{i}+y\hat{j}+z\hat{k}$ gives
$$2(x-1)+y+3(z-1)=0$$
Therefore,
$$2x+y+3z-5=0$$

Verification
For $A(1,0,1)$, $2(1)+0+3(1)-5=0$. For $B(2,1,0)$, $2(2)+1+0-5=0$. For $C(0,2,1)$, $0+2+3-5=0$. Thus all three points satisfy the obtained equation.

Final Result
The vector equation of the plane is $\left[\vec{r}-(\hat{i}+\hat{k})\right]\cdot(2\hat{i}+\hat{j}+3\hat{k})=0$, and its Cartesian equation is $2x+y+3z-5=0$.

options.A: Vector form: $[\vec r-(\hat i+\hat k)]\cdot(2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k)=0$; Cartesian form: $2x-y+3z-5=0$
options.B: Vector form: $[\vec r-(\hat i+\hat k)]\cdot(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)=0$; Cartesian form: $x+2y+3z-4=0$
options.C: Vector form: $[\vec r-(\hat i+\hat k)]\cdot(2\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k)=0$; Cartesian form: $2x+y-3z+1=0$
options.D: Vector form: $[\vec r-(\hat i+\hat k)]\cdot(2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k)=0$; Cartesian form: $2x+y+3z-5=0$; all three given points satisfy it.
